editorial.overview: The SAS Certified Advanced Programmer exam, officially certified by SAS Institute, evaluates advanced data management and programming skills. Candidates must answer a total of 60 questions across three distinct domains during a timed session lasting 110 minutes, and achieve a passing score of 65% to earn this certification credential successfully.
editorial.preparation_strategy: To prepare effectively for this certification assessment, review official exam guides and documentation provided directly by SAS Institute. Practice writing complex SQL queries, managing macro variables, and applying advanced programming constructs to reinforce your technical knowledge before test day. Check with SAS Institute for the current certification path.
